WHAT IS IT :: A life-saver earthquake meter & alarm always in your pocket.

WHO IT’S FOR :: Everyone that wants to protect own self or family. Also a helpful app when training for earthquake disaster.

WHY IS USEFUL :: It can alarm you at night and can save you important seconds to act as planned on an earthquake.

HOW IT WORKS?
• Select Scale (Liedu, USGS, Shindo or Mercalli)
• Select Shaking Level (press "?" to view intensity table)
• Press "TEST" to see & hear the alarm
• Leave device in a steady surface (eg floor)
• Enable Seismometer (tap in the centre circle)

It senses and translates movements into the four most used earthquake intensity scales in the world:
• Shindo (Japan)
• USGS (USA)
• Liedu (China)
• Mercalli (World)


* main functionality does not require internet connection (3G or WiFi), some minor require (help & privacy view, email to support, etc)
**seismos is the greek word “σεισμός” that means earthquake
